functions.name: c00_simple_if
functions.source: function c00_simple_if(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level if adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c01_nested_if
functions.source: function c01_nested_if(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) { if (b) return true; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer if adds 1; the nested if adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c02_triple_nested_if
functions.source: function c02_triple_nested_if(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) { if (b) { if (c) return true; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: Three nested ifs add 1, 2, and 3 respectively.

functions.name: c03_if_else
functions.source: function c03_if_else(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) return true; else return false; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if and its else each add one; else is hybrid.

functions.name: c04_if_elif_else
functions.source: function c04_if_elif_else(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) return true; else if (b) return false; else return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if, else-if, and else each add one; else-if is hybrid.

functions.name: c05_three_way_chain
functions.source: function c05_three_way_chain(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) return true; else if (b) return false; else if (c) return true; else return false; return false; }
functions.derivation: One if, two else-if branches, and one else add four total.

functions.name: c06_and_sequence
functions.source: function c06_and_sequence(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a && b) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c07_or_sequence
functions.source: function c07_or_sequence(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a || b) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator || sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c08_mixed_boolean
functions.source: function c08_mixed_boolean(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a && b || c && d) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; &&, ||, && form three logical sequences, adding 3.

functions.name: c09_assigned_boolean
functions.source: function c09_assigned_boolean(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { const value = a && b; return value; return false; }
functions.derivation: A binary logical sequence in an assignment adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c10_while_loop
functions.source: function c10_while_loop(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { while (a) { a = false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level while adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c11_for_loop
functions.source: function c11_for_loop(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { for (const item of [a, b]) { void item; } return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level loop adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c12_if_with_loop
functions.source: function c12_if_with_loop(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) { for (const item of [b, c]) { void item; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; the loop nested inside it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c13_nested_loops
functions.source: function c13_nested_loops(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { for (const item of [a, b]) { while (item) { break; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer loop adds 1; the inner loop adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c14_switch_or_match
functions.source: function c14_switch_or_match(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { switch (a) { case true: return true; default: return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The switch/match/select construct adds one; its alternatives add no further points.

functions.name: c15_switch_nested_if
functions.source: function c15_switch_nested_if(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { switch (a) { case true: if (b) return true; break; default: return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The switch adds 1; the if nested in it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c16_try_one_catch
functions.source: function c16_try_one_catch(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { try { if (a) return true; } catch (error) { return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: Try is ignored; the if adds 1 and each catch adds 1.

functions.name: c17_try_two_catches
functions.source: function c17_try_two_catches(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { try { if (a) return true; } catch (error) { if (b) return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: Try adds nothing; the if adds 1; catch adds 1 and increases nesting, so its nested if adds 1 + 1 more.

functions.name: c18_recursive_call
functions.source: function c18_recursive_call(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) return true; return c18_recursive_call(b, a); return false; }
functions.derivation: The base-case if adds 1; one direct recursive call adds 1 fundamental recursion increment.

functions.name: c19_conditional_expression
functions.source: function c19_conditional_expression(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { return a ? true : false; return false; }
functions.derivation: One ternary/conditional expression adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c20_nested_conditionals
functions.source: function c20_nested_conditionals(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { return a ? true : (b ? false : true); return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer conditional adds 1; its nested conditional adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c21_lambda_decision
functions.source: function c21_lambda_decision(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { return [a].some(value => { if (value) return true; return false; }); return false; }
functions.derivation: The lambda adds no structural point but raises nesting; its if adds 1 + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c22_if_lambda_decision
functions.source: function c22_if_lambda_decision(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) return [b].some(value => { if (value) return true; return false; }); return false; }
functions.derivation: Outer if adds 1; lambda if adds 1 + 2 nesting levels (outer if and lambda).

functions.name: c23_nested_callable
functions.source: function c23_nested_callable(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { function inner() { if (a) return true; return false; } return inner(); return false; }
functions.derivation: Nested callable adds no structural point but one nesting level to its if (1 + 1).

functions.name: c24_try_finally
functions.source: function c24_try_finally(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { try { if (a) return true; } finally { cleanup(); } return false; }
functions.derivation: Try and finally add nothing; the top-level if inside the try adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c25_labeled_jump
functions.source: function c25_labeled_jump(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { outer: while (a) { break outer; } return false; }
functions.derivation: One loop adds 1; the labeled jump adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c26_boolean_operator_sequences
functions.source: function c26_boolean_operator_sequences(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { return a && (b || c); }
functions.derivation: The return expression contains one && sequence and one || sequence, for two fundamental increments.

functions.name: c27_language_idiom
functions.source: function c27_language_idiom(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { for (const item of [a, b]) { if (item) return true; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The loop adds 1; its nested if adds 1 structural + 1 nesting, totaling 3.

functions.name: c28_loop_if_boolean
functions.source: function c28_loop_if_boolean(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { for (const item of [a, b]) { if (item && a) return true; } return false; }
functions.derivation: Loop adds 1; nested if adds 1 + 1 nesting; its && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c29_else_loop
functions.source: function c29_else_loop(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): boolean { if (a) return true; else { while (b) { break; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; its else adds 1. The loop in the else body is at nesting level 1, so it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting, totaling 4.
